how-23-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the tree bark, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-23-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the tree bark, then tap three things you notice.

how-23-01-compare.page: Put the flashlight under one tray and the cup under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Shine the light. Then swap and try again.
how-23-01-compare.say: Put the flashlight under one tray and the cup under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Shine the light. Then swap and try again.

how-23-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-23-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-23-01-det.page: Pick 3 scenes, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick who is harmed. Predict land, water, or air, and watch the place today appear.
how-23-01-det.say: Pick three scenes, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick who is harmed. Predict land, water, or air, and watch the place today appear.

how-23-01-partc.page: Draw an outdoor place with one type of pollution getting into it. Label where it comes from, and one living thing it harms.
how-23-01-partc.say: Draw an outdoor place with one type of pollution getting into it. Label where it comes from, and one living thing it harms.
